notes.title: Update: Puzzle Fixes for Impossible Levels!
notes.notes:
Hello, Neko Times players! 🐾

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to share that this update addresses some tricky (and impossible!) levels caused by incorrect puzzle pieces. We’ve thoroughly checked and corrected the pieces to ensure all levels are solvable, while still providing a satisfying challenge. Thank you for helping us make Neko Times: Purrfect Shapes even better!

Happy puzzling and let us know if you have any more feedback!
